Creator tips

Method

How the scores are built

Scores combine simple heuristics: how many creators cover a topic, how recently it appears, and how much room is left for a new angle. They are for brainstorming only.

They are not search volume, and they do not predict reach. Check them against your own audience before you commit to a series.

FAQ

Questions about content trends

Are these live search-volume trends?

No. Ideas and scores are heuristic brainstorming aids, not verified search-volume charts or live demand measurements.

Do the suggestions guarantee views or growth?

No. Audience interest, creative execution, timing, and platform distribution all affect performance.

What should I do with an idea?

Review recent platform content, adapt the angle to your expertise, and test with your own audience.
